task: Instructor/Faculty review module redesign (Capstone 1, 2, 3 tabs unified to compact sectionized format, added manuscripts and publications, eradicated Image 2 citation placeholders)
lessonsLearned: ChapterReviewPanel supports extraItems array allowing custom manuscript targets (e.g. Capstone 1 1-3 proposal or Capstone 3 Compiled Final Paper) to render inside the unified chapter progression pipeline without duplicating cards.
Sectionized cards with collapsible headers (InteractiveGanttChart, ActionDoneMatrixTab, EvaluationPanel, Academic Paper & Journal) provide consistent visual rhythm and prevent scrolling fatigue.
Removing unbacked UI elements (such as empty citation boxes [APA 7th] and [IEEE] or unpersisted static abstract placeholders) eliminates AI slop and ensures 100% data integrity.
For Playwright audits on horizontal scrolling tab bars, dispatching with force: true prevents locator click hanging on overflow containers.
